newsitem.title: USA: Score Board names James O'Malley CFO.
newsitem.headline: Score Board names James O'Malley CFO.

text.p: The Score Board Inc said it has named James O'Malley, 45, as its chief financial officer, replacing Michael Hoppman, who is leaving the company to pursue other interests.
Score Board also said that Raymond Abrahamsen, 50, is joining in the newly-created position of senior vice president of trading card sales and marketing and retail memorabilia.
O'Malley was most recently vice president and CFO for Geriatric & Medical Companies Inc. His background also includes over 10 years with Arthur Andersen LLP.
